About ↑···

RAGE  Mode

Born and raised in Dhaka, RAGE has spent over a decade building Bangladesh's hip-hop ecosystem from the ground up. One Wall, One Beat, One Event at a time. He founded The Renegades in 2012, the country's first graffiti crew, then carried the same obsession into production, DJing and live performance.

Hustling the hustle

As a founding member of Wrong Side since 2019, one of the country's most influential hip-hop collectives, RAGE sits at the intersection of all four pillars of hip-hop culture. Recognised as Bangladesh's first finger drummer, he continues to push the boundary of what live hip-hop looks like in South Asia. While organising the community events that keep the underground alive.

Walls · Stages · Studio · Dhaka

RAGE Mode
in the Scene

Since 2012

Dhaka walls saw RAGE as a cofounder of the first graffiti crew, Renegades.

Since 2018

From walls to beats Rage Mode started out hustling with selling 2 beat tapes since 2018 debuting single on Spotify's official Bangla Hip-Hop Central playlist with RAGE MODE EP (2024).

From Walls to DJ Sets

Being a pioneer DJ and vinyl selector RAGE MODE started performing across Dhaka at intimate sessions, full venue shows, and community events.

Pioneering Finger Drumming

RAGE MODE is the first finger drummer bringing live percussive pad-controller performance to the country's hip-hop stage.

Self-taught. Brought the same obsessive discipline from walls to beats and decks — Pioneer and vinyl from day one.
